name: Dumbbell Fly
steps: Lie flat on a bench with feet planted and your shoulder blades set back against the pad.
Hold two dumbbells above your chest with palms facing each other and a soft bend in your elbows.
Open your arms in wide arcs until your upper arms are roughly level with your torso.
Sweep both dumbbells back together above your chest along the same arc.
tips: Keep the bend in your elbows steady throughout the movement.
Stop lowering before your shoulders roll forward or pull painfully at the front.
